name: Chicken and rice
steps: Rinse 1 cup rice. Slice chicken into thin strips and season with salt and pepper.
In a saucepan, bring 1½ cups water and the rice to a boil. Cover, lower heat, and simmer about 12 minutes until tender. Turn off the heat and leave covered.
While the rice cooks, heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Cook the chicken, stirring often, until browned and the thickest part reads 165°F (74°C) on a food thermometer.
Fluff the rice with a fork, fold in the chicken, and let sit 1 minute off heat before serving.

name: Egg fried rice
steps: If the rice is not already cooked, simmer 1 cup rice in 1½ cups water in a saucepan, covered, for 12 minutes. Spread on a plate and cool 5 minutes so the grains stay separate in the pan.
Dice half the onion finely. Beat 2 eggs with a pinch of salt.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Scramble the eggs until just set, transfer to a plate.
Add a little more oil to the skillet. Cook the onion 2 minutes, stir in the rice, and cook 3–4 minutes until hot. Fold the eggs back in, season with salt and pepper, and serve.

name: Chicken tortilla wrap
steps: Slice chicken into thin strips and season with salt and pepper. Slice half the onion into thin rings.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high. Cook the chicken, stirring often, until browned and the thickest part reads 165°F (74°C) on a food thermometer. Transfer to a plate and tent loosely.
In the same skillet, cook the onion 2 minutes until softened. Transfer to the plate with the chicken.
Steam the tortillas in a covered pot with a splash of water over medium heat until pliable, about 1 minute.
Fill tortillas with chicken and onion, roll tightly, and serve.

name: Spinach and eggs
steps: Beat 2 eggs with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a nonstick pan over medium. Add spinach in handfuls and cook until fully wilted, about 3 minutes. Transfer the spinach to a plate.
Add a little more oil to the pan if needed. Pour in the eggs and stir gently until softly set, about 3 minutes.
Fold the wilted spinach back into the eggs, adjust seasoning, and serve right away.
